sectionHeader.title: Voices of Our Esteemed Custodians
sectionHeader.description: Authentic reflections from architectural collectors, international family offices, and patrons who entrusted their acquisitions to Verdant.

testimonials.name: Evelyn & Marcus Vance
testimonials.property: Acquired The Glass House Sanctuary, Montecito ($5.2M)
testimonials.quote: Verdant understood our architectural requirements with surgeon-like precision. They secured an extraordinary modern pavilion off-market before public release. Their discretion and escrow execution were flawless.

testimonials.name: Julian De La Tour
testimonials.property: Sold Historic Bel Air Compound ($18.5M Off-Market)
testimonials.quote: Selling a legacy estate requires absolute confidentiality. Verdant orchestrated private showings with three qualified global principals, concluding the sale at full ask in under 28 days without a single public trace.

testimonials.name: Dr. Aris & Claire Thorne
testimonials.quote: The depth of their architectural knowledge sets them apart from every other agency. They understood the engineering behind the geothermal systems and guided our acquisition with unparalleled sophistication.

testimonials.name: Soren Lindqvist
testimonials.quote: Verdant's Private Advisory team connected us with Olson Kundig's coastal master project six months prior to public announcement. Their insight into luxury capital appreciation is peerless.

testimonials.name: Amara & David Sterling
testimonials.quote: Securing a direct deep-water dock for our sailing catamaran was non-negotiable. Verdant identified the only private bayfront property that met every maritime specification.

testimonials.name: Lady Henrietta Beaufort
testimonials.quote: From London, we entrusted the entire process to Verdant. Their market valuation was accurate to the decimal, and they handled all architectural preservation covenants seamlessly.
